scope: Diagnosis and experiment specification only; no estimator edits, numerical runs or new long campaigns this turn.
objectives: Attribute the low-noise center/precision discrepancy before selecting a repair.
Distinguish weak capacity identification from avoidable representation or solver error.
Preserve useful state estimates and joint uncertainty through repetitive or quiet use.

stage0.source_binding: Original sources, binary, public calibration, input chronology and controller/RNG recipe; compare at saved checkpoints, hash regenerated prefix.
stage0.truth_interface: Harness may simulate truth; fitting API receives indexed dt/I/T/V and declared sensor calibration only. Truth scoring separate after fits freeze.

stage1.weak_holdout_origin: New declared continuation; absent from4h archive.
stage1.prior: Original public prior once per complete prefix. Never add replayed-data likelihood to a posterior from the same data.

initializations.selection: lowest converged training objective; keep unresolved starts

profile_grid.nuisance: reoptimize other15 initial-chart coordinates preserving joint prior
profile_grid.interpretation: objective profiles, not marginal posterior or exact exclusions

common_anchor_metrics: full and partitioned weighted residual/Jacobian defect
GN curvature and directional exact-Hessian check
stage1.partition_attribution: g_j=B_exact.T@d_j+DeltaB_j.T@r_field; sum over physical response groups equals total gradient defect; cross terms retained
stage1.prediction: No refit on heldout samples; local joint predictive covariance, conditional on recorded I/T; common score measure; no coverage claim from selected witnesses

stage2_uncertainty.high_noise_extension: Only if needed to discriminate noise scaling; paired cases0004/0006.
stage2_uncertainty.sensor_control: Exact physical response with discrete Gaussian-integrated ADC-bin likelihood; public delta=1/1024V and analog sigma. Optional unquantized matched-innovation control with frozen recorded I/T; never silently change closed-loop load.
stage2_uncertainty.720h_reference: Deferred unless shorter prefixes leave a duration-specific ambiguity; must regenerate complete prefix for exact-data claim.
stage2_uncertainty.repair_rule: Select a response/transport/solver/sensor or discrepancy representation only after attribution. No automatic scalar inflation, forgetting or decay.

fork_rules: Same physical/estimator parent boundary and original prior/history.
Distinct source lineage per continuation; same input stream across inference arms.
Measured-voltage/domain guards only; report any truncated intervention.
Fixed registered noise continuation state/counter mapping, no reselection.
stage2_weak_stimulus.forecast: Freeze estimates at4h and score first-hour continuation separately from online assimilation.

standalone_null.identity: Physical voltage likelihood independent of Q and gamma; independent Q prior is preserved. Not asserted for rest after excitation.

stage2_weak_stimulus.sensitivity: Compare nuisance-residualized Q Jacobian, data-only information, prior contribution, full joint profile, prior sensitivity, state and heldout errors.

prior_sensitivity.covariance: Scale Q row of prior root by2 for alternative; retain cross-correlations.
prior_sensitivity.scope: Retained-data diagnostic first, separately labeled field-domain limits; no truth-based prior selection or production inflation.

conditional_validation.limits: 32 seeds per stratum is a calibration pilot, not proof of3-sigma tail coverage. Do not pool correlated time samples or paired strata as independent trials.

storage.case_cache_policy: One case at a time; no raw truth/trace CSV. Original evidence untouched.
storage.discrepancy_payload_scope: Directions16*k, meansk and triangular k*k covariance root; excludes metadata/workspace/online statistics. Not a selected or qualified repair.

deliverables: source/recipe identities and compact regeneration receipt
exact versus field Q profiles and joint sensitivities
separate postfit truth and predictive scoring
resource estimate and evidence-based next repair decision
prohibited_shortcuts: exponential forgetting or hidden health decay
claiming exact full history from a late compressed checkpoint
calling finite local coverage an aging or M23 certificate
